reason: Lint: View's open row (Theme or Language) is reset during render when View closes, instead of from an effect (ViewMenu:53, react/set-state-in-effect). The reset was measured to be needed: with it switched off, a press on the canvas closes View before the row's own outside-press listener runs, and a click with no mousedown (a script's click(), or an activation that sends only a click) reaches no such listener, so the row came back open when View opened again. Four new theme-submenu tests pin both closes for both rows; they pass on the code before the change, fail with the reset switched off, and pass with the new form. Twelve close paths, keyboard ones included, give the same result as before. npm run lint fails above 58 warnings (was 59). #625 item 5.
